calculators.formula_explanation: Net Business Income = Gross Revenue - Expenses - Blue Deduction. Taxable Income = Net Business Income - Basic Exemption (480,000 yen for income <= 24M yen) - Dependent Allowance (380,000 yen per qualifying dependent). National Income Tax = Taxable Income * Tax Bracket Rate (5% to 45%) - Progressive Deduction + 2.1% Reconstruction Special Income Tax. Local Residence Tax = Taxable Income * 10% + Per Capita Flat Rate (~5,000 yen). Personal Business Tax = (Net Business Income + Blue Deduction - 2,900,000 yen Owner Allowance) * Business Tax Rate (0% to 5%). National Health Insurance (NHI) = Income-based levy (~7%-10% of prior year net income) + Per-head levy (~40,000 yen/person) capped by municipal upper limit (~1,040,000 yen/year). Net Take-Home Pay = Net Business Income - Income Tax - Residence Tax - Business Tax - NHI.

calculators.formula_explanation: Residence Tax Income Portion (住民税所得割額) = (Gross Salary - Employment Income Deduction - Social Insurance Deduction - Basic Exemption - Dependent Deductions - Annual iDeCo) * 10%. Furusato Max Limit = (Residence Tax Income Portion * 20%) / (90% - Marginal Income Tax Rate * 1.021) + 2,000 yen. Edge case: Total tax deduction cannot exceed total residence tax + income tax paid. Actual out-of-pocket cost is exactly 2,000 yen when donation is within calculated limit.

calculators.formula_explanation: Standard Monthly Remuneration (標準報酬月額) calculated from Monthly Gross Salary. Health Insurance Premium = Standard Remuneration * Prefectural Health Rate / 2 (Employee half). Welfare Pension (厚生年金) = Standard Remuneration * 18.3% / 2 (9.15% Employee share, capped at 650,000 yen/month grade). Nursing Care Insurance (介護保険, ages 40-64) = Standard Remuneration * 1.60% / 2 (0.80% Employee share). Employment Insurance (雇用保険) = Gross Salary * 0.6% (General Industry Employee share). Income Tax Withholding = Calculated from National Tax Agency Compensation Withholding Table based on (Gross Salary - Social Insurance Deductions) and Dependent Count. Residence Tax = (Prior Year Income - Deductions) * 10% / 12 months. Monthly Take-Home Pay = Monthly Gross Salary - (Health Insurance + Pension + Nursing + Employment + Income Tax + Residence Tax).

calculators.formula_explanation: Real Estate Acquisition Tax (不動産取得税): Building Tax = (Building Assessed Value - 12,000,000 yen Special Reduction for qualifying residential property) * 3% (Residential tax rate). Land Tax = (Land Assessed Value * 1/2 [Residential Tax Base Tax Reduction] * 3%) - Tax Credit (minimum 45,000 yen or Land m2 value * 1/2 * 3% * Building Floor Area * 2). Registration License Tax (登録免許税): Building Ownership Preservation/Transfer Tax = Building Assessed Value * 0.15% (New home reduced) or 0.3% (Used home reduced). Land Ownership Transfer Tax = Land Assessed Value * 1.5% (Residential reduced rate). Mortgage Registration Tax = Mortgage Amount * 0.1% (Residential reduced rate for mortgage creation). Judicial Scrivener Fee (司法書士報酬) estimated at 80,000 to 150,000 yen.

calculators.description_native: 遺産総額と法定相続人の構成（配偶者の有無、子の人数）から、基礎控除額、各相続人の法定相続分に応じた相続税額、配偶者の税額軽減（1億6,000万円枠）適用後の実質納付額を試算します。

inputs.label_native: 配偶者の実際の取得割合 (%)

calculators.formula_explanation: Inheritance Tax Basic Exemption (基礎控除額) = 30,000,000 yen + (6,000,000 yen * Number of Statutory Heirs). Taxable Estate Net = Total Estate Value - Basic Exemption. If Taxable Estate Net <= 0, Total Tax is 0. Statutory Share Allocation: If spouse and children present, Spouse gets 50%, Children share 50% equally. Progressive Tax Table applied to each statutory share (10% under 10M yen up to 55% over 600M yen minus tax bracket deduction). Sum of all statutory taxes forms Total Inheritance Tax Pot. Allocated to each heir by actual inheritance percentage. Spouse Tax Credit (配偶者の税額軽減): Spouse pays 0 yen if Spouse's acquired portion <= max(160,000,000 yen, Spouse Statutory Share Value). Total Payable Tax = Sum of (Heir Allocated Tax - Applicable Credits).
